description:
Blue River Carp, Inc. is a Shopify-based e-commerce brand selling preserved invasive Asian carp cut-bait for catching catfish and other predator fish —a product with genuine, defensible differentiation in a largely unsophisticated advertising category. The brand’s biggest strength is a structural content advantage no competitor can replicate: the invasive species origin story is uncontested across every platform, emotionally resonant, inherently shareable, and positions the buyer as a conservation hero. The most significant vulnerability is that this story is almost entirely absent from current advertising and website copy, leaving Our/Your most powerful hook on the table. The single most important action is activating the invasive carp / eco-narrative as the primary brand hook across Meta, TikTok, and Google — this angle alone can drive viral organic reach and your 15% commision through the roof. 

About Us: We are a small business located in Marengo, Indiana and our products are made from the invasive Asian Carp (Bighead and Silver Carp) out of Ohio River and a few other tributaries. As you may know, these invasive carp are a huge problem for the ecosystem. Using them as bait is a great way to remove them and create a few jobs.

Our products are 100% made from the invasive Asian carp, using our patented process to preserve it. Our preservation process creates huge benefits:

· Pre-cut pieces vary in size, shape, and color

· Eco-friendly- saving native fish

· Requires “NO” refrigeration and freezing

· Excellent oil slick time

· Perfect for rod and reel, trotlines, jugs, drifting, yoyo, and limb lines

· Catches a variety of game fish, not just catfish

· EXTREMELY TOUGH

· Shelf-Life beyond 12 months even after opening

Blue River Carp is the only catfish bait brand with a built-in viral story (invasive species + conservation + real fish + no refrigeration), giving it a structural content and differentiation advantage that no competitor can replicate without changing their product.

Our affiliates can earn: 15.00% per order and samples are available to use and test if your an angler. 

How to promote us: 

Strongest Hook: “Asian carp are destroying American rivers — so we turned them into catfish bait.” — Entirely unique in the bait category, carries environmental urgency, triggers genuine curiosity, and cannot be replicated by any competitor.

Angle 1 — “The Bait That Fights Back Against Invasive Carp” You’re not just buying bait — every bag = carp harvested from the Ohio/Mississippi system. Positions customer as conservation hero. Tone: Proud, purposeful, slightly rebellious.

Angle 2 — “The Only Catfish Bait You Leave in Your Boat Year-Round” Real cut bait. No cooler. No fridge. 12+ months. FishBites also claims no refrigeration but is artificial — Blue River Carp is real fish at the same price point. Tone: Practical,confident, lifestyle-first.

Angle 3 — “100% Real Carp. 100% Real Catfish Results.” Radical ingredient transparency in a category full of mystery formulas. Catfish evolved eating carp — this is the natural choice. Tone: Scientific-ish but accessible.

Counter-hooks against specific competitors: - vs. FishBites: “25 years of artificial. We use the real thing.” - vs. Magic Bait:“Dough bait has been around since 1970. So has the Asian carp invasion. We turned one problem into the other’s solution.” -vs. Catfish Pro: “You don’t need a $184 rod. You need bait that actually works.”

I am able to provide scripts, hooks, and other materials if requested.
